cand.question: Does the Lawrence-Venkatesh method on variations of Hodge structures attached to covers branched at orders (p, q, r) apply across varying exponent families or is it restricted to fixed algebraic families?
cand.context: Lawrence-Venkatesh (Annals 2020) uses p-adic period maps and Galois representations to prove Mordell / Faltings for families of varieties over a fixed base. Does varying the branch orders (p, q, r) break the constancy of the Hodge structure family?
